[SWS_PHM_01331]
{DRAFT}
Start of Alive Supervision
⌈
The
Platform Health
Management
shall start the first
aliveReferenceCycle
of a configured
AliveSu-
pervision
of a
Supervised Entity
Instance as soon as the corresponding pro-
cess reports Execution State
kRunning
.
⌋
(RS_HM_09125, RS_HM_09249)
Rationale: Cyclic execution is expected only after process reached state
kRunning
.
Execution Management monitors that the process reaches state
kRunning
within a
configured timeout.
The information of process reporting Execution state
kRunning
is to be provided by
Execution Management. through a vendor specific Inter Functional Cluster Interface.
